integrity: The statement is proved by an explicit propagation classification and independently replayed by exhaustive subset enumeration for orders 6 through 16. Closest full-text sources were compared at the statement and implication level; an unindexed equivalent result remains a residual literature risk.
limitations: Ordinary power domination on book graphs only; no claim is made for other power-domination variants or arbitrary Cartesian products. The all-orders theorem is analytic; exhaustive computation is used only as a finite verification check.
title: Power domination polynomial of book graphs
